structured.answer: Keep only this month's money and a small cushion in the עו"ש. The rest of the 30k should go somewhere else, probably a קרן כספית, because the page says money sitting a whole quarter above the legal threshold (15,000 ₪) "כבר שייך במקום אחר". The page never told me the actual cost in shekels, only "לפי התעריפון".

stuck.why: It uses a 5% yearly return on a current account, while the text says a current account doesn't always pay interest. I couldn't tell if this is what my account would do.
I wanted a shekel cost and got only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'.

stuck.where: Red box at the top of screen 3
stuck.why: A lock and 'שאלה פתוחה' about tax. Felt like a warning I didn't understand.
It says the עו"ש is better only for money needed that same day, but doesn't tell me which fund or how to get one.
